sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def st(f):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    p=None
    for r in range(36,45):
        for c in range(6,16):
            if r<len(L) and c<len(L[r]) and L[r][c]=='N': p=(r,c);break
        if p:break
    red='top' if L[25][19]=='R' else 'mid'
    blue='p1' if L[20][18]=='b' else 'p3'
    return (p,red,blue)
def win(res):
    return any(res.get(k) for k in ('level_completed','done','run_complete','game_over'))
print("current:",st(current_frame))
RED={'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':48}
BLU={'action':'MOUSE','row':36,'col':48}
seq=[BLU,RED,BLU,  # col12: p1,mid-p1,mid-p3
     'LEFT',RED,BLU,RED,  # col10: mid-p3,top-p3,top-p1,mid-p1
     'LEFT',BLU,RED,BLU]  # col8: mid-p1,mid-p3,top-p3,top-p1
seen=set()
for i,a in enumerate(seq):
    r=action([a])
    s=st(current_frame); seen.add(s)
    w=win(last_action_result)
    print(i,a if isinstance(a,str) else ('RED' if a['row']==19 else 'BLU'),s,'WIN!' if w else '')
    if w: break
print("row42 states seen:",sorted([s for s in seen if s[0][0]==42]))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
